LESSON: ATTRIBUTES OF ALLAH

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.1: Attributes of Allah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Attributes of Allah
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What are the favours of Allah (S.W.T.) to mankind?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. apply the attributes of Allah (S.W.T.) while making dua
2. appreciate the unique attributes of Allah (S.W.T.) as part of Islamic faith

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: apply the attributes of Allah (S.W.T.) while making dua

Teach
• Today’s focus: apply the attributes of Allah (S.W.T.) while making dua.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “apply the attributes of Allah (S.W.T.) while making dua” using a school example.
• Model B for “apply the attributes of Allah (S.W.T.) while making dua” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "apply the attributes of Allah (S.W.T.) while making dua" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: appreciate the unique attributes of Allah (S.W.T.) as part of Islamic faith

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate the unique attributes of Allah (S.W.T.) as part of Islamic faith.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “appreciate the unique attributes of Allah (S.W.T.) as part of Islamic faith” using a school example.
• Model B for “appreciate the unique attributes of Allah (S.W.T.) as part of Islamic faith” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate the unique attributes of Allah (S.W.T.) as part of Islamic faith" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: apply the attributes of Allah (S.W.T.) while making dua
• Model 2: appreciate the unique attributes of Allah (S.W.T.) as part of Islamic faith

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: apply the attributes of Allah (S.W.T.) while making dua
2. Practise: appreciate the unique attributes of Allah (S.W.T.) as part of Islamic faith

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Attributes of Allah.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are the favours of Allah (S.W.T.) to mankind?
2. What are the attributes of Allah (S.W.T.)?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• apply the attributes of Allah (S.W.T.) while making dua
• appreciate the unique attributes of Allah (S.W.T.) as part of Islamic faith
